en: Sepia-toned photographic postcard showing a uniformed guard or soldier standing in front of a chevron-striped sentry box. He wears a pickelhaube-style spiked helmet and holds a short sword at his side. In the upper right corner, a young woman in traditional dress leans out from what seems to be a window or balcony, offering him a flower. The scene appears staged, likely in a studio, and there is no visible printed text on the image side.
